title: 16th Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/16/2/2025).
First reading of the government-sponsored Maldives Intellectual Property Office Bill, submitted by Kudahuvadhoo MP Hussain Hameed.
Preliminary debate on the government-sponsored Maldives Intellectual Property Office Bill, submitted by Kudahuvadhoo MP Hussain Hameed.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the government-sponsored Trademark Bill, submitted by Maduvvari MP Ahmed Zahir.

Report of the Judiciary Committee on the candidates who responded to the Majlis Secretariat's announcement for the member of the public to be appointed by Parliament to the Judicial Service Commission, under Article 158(f) of the Constitution and Article 3(6) of Law No. 10/2008 (Judicial Service Commission Act).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to introduce and begin debating the Intellectual Property Office Bill, continue the Trademark Bill debate, and consider the Judiciary Committee's report on candidates for the public seat on the Judicial Service Commission.
